translationRepairs: Earlier the great commanders Cao Wenchao and Ai Wannian had fallen in battle, You Shiwei had been beaten, and most generals were so afraid of the rebels that they would not advance; Xiangsheng would weep openly in his indignation and stir them with talk of loyalty and duty.

Earlier the great commanders Cao Wenzhao and Ai Wannian had fallen in battle, You Shiwei had been beaten, and most generals were so afraid of the rebels that they would not advance; Xiangsheng would weep openly in his indignation and stir them with talk of loyalty and duty.
曹文詔 is read Cáo Wénzhào.
Yang Sichang had meanwhile left mourning to head the Secretariat; Chen Xin Jia was also recalled to the center, while Xiangsheng was left in mourning dress awaiting his successor.
Yang Sichang had meanwhile left mourning to head the Ministry of War; Chen Xinjia was also recalled to the center, while Xiangsheng was left in mourning dress awaiting his successor.
中樞 here means the Ministry of War; 陳新甲 is Chen Xinjia.
Xin Jia was still distant and did not arrive at once.
Xinjia was still distant and did not arrive at once.
新甲 is a single given name, Xinjia.
Xin Jia reached Changping as well, and Xiangsheng gave him a share of the force.
Xinjia reached Changping as well, and Xiangsheng gave him a share of the force.
新甲 is a single given name, Xinjia.
When he fell, the notable Gu Xian died beside him, and the entire force was wiped out.
When he fell, his servant Gu Xian died with him, and the entire force was wiped out.
仆(僕)顧顯 means his servant Gu Xian, not a notable.
Shunde Prefect Yu Ying filed a report from the wall; Sichang deliberately held it back, and the burial waited eighty days.
Shunde Prefect Yu Ying submitted a report; Sichang deliberately held it back, and the burial waited eighty days.
上狀 means submitted a report; there is no wall.

They seized Liangxiang, withdrew to Lugou, killed more than seven thousand of Fu's men that night, and at dawn ambushed the great commanders Man Gui and Sun Shou, taking Heiyunlong and Ma Dengyun alive.

They seized Liangxiang, withdrew to Lugou, killed more than seven thousand of Fu's men that night, and at dawn ambushed the great commanders Man Gui and Sun Zushou, taking Hei Yunlong and Ma Dengyun alive.
孫祖壽 is Sun Zushou; 黑雲龍 is Hei Yunlong.
Zhilun agreed with Ma Shilong and Wu Zimian to rush from Ji toward Yongping and pin the enemy, while he led eight columns against Zunhua.
Zhilun agreed with Regional Commanders Ma Shilong and Wu Zimian to rush from Ji toward Yongping and pin the enemy, while he led eight columns against Zunhua.
The Qing sent repeated summons; Dashou agreed; only Vice General Ke Gang refused.
The Qing sent repeated summons; Dashou agreed; only Vice General Kegang refused.
